name: Raphael Steinbach
headline: Chief Executive Officer @ ADA Cosmetics Americas | Putting beauty into travel.
summary:
International executive with 12+ years of expertise in business development and sales systems. Developed passionate teams, supported by an innovative and scalable sales framework to deliver solutions that turned customers into fans and partners. 

Experience includes successfully running an operation with 30+ team members, managing finances for eight-figure businesses, and developing sales teams to create multi-million dollar per year growth from scratch.

Currently serving as the Head of Product and Marketing for Würth USA, I focus on maximizing sales through innovative product lines, impactful marketing campaigns, and enhancing sales effectiveness through training and tech. My career journey, deeply intertwined with a commitment to operational excellence and innovative solutions, has been a fulfilling expedition of driving sales and spearheading transformative initiatives.

At Würth USA, my mission is to establish seamless integration between diverse operational facets and to pioneer strategies that elevate organizational performance and profitability. From implementing impactful marketing campaigns to introducing the highest-selling product line since 2019, every step I take is driven by a resolve to achieve unparalleled excellence.

However, my passion extends beyond sales and marketing and encompasses a deep interest in nurturing talent and fostering a conducive environment for professional growth. The essence of my approach lies in unveiling the untapped potential within processes and people, fueling a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

If you share a passion for innovation, operational excellence, and transformative leadership, I would be thrilled to connect with you.

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description:
Ada Cosmetics has the most hygienic and sustainable shampoo, soap, conditioner and lotion dispensers in the world. Patented dispensing technology and carefully crafted lotions and soaps deliver a refreshing and cleansing experience to the weary traveler. We all know how refreshing a nice shower feels after a long day. Ada is the only manufacturer in this space that is cradle to cradle certified for all products reducing tons of waste and ensuring only the highest quality ingredients are used. 

We are building a team that is turning the amenities space upside down in North America. 

Let us know if you want to be part of the journey!
